title: What are some common problems in UNOX oven?
desc: Oven Doesn't Cook Evenly: P-trap not installed: Contact a FAJ technician to resolve this issue. P-trap is empty: Fill the P-trap by pouring a jar of water down the drain. Damaged gasket: Replace the gasket. Clogged chimney: Clean the chimney using a metal brush.

title: What are the benefits of using an UNOX oven?
desc: Every component of Unox restaurant ovens is designed for precision, ensuring consistent cooking results and complete control over temperature, humidity, and time.

title: What foods should not be cooked in a convection oven?
desc: Here is a quick list of items generally best avoided in convection ovens: delicate soufflés and custards, cakes that require gentle baking, and certain breads with specific rising needs.

title: What is not allowed in the oven?
desc: No type of plastic should be used in the oven; this includes styrofoam, plastic food storage containers, and cookware with plastic, silicone, or nylon handles.
